function.name: query_business_context
function.description: Resolve one material business-meaning gap through the server-configured read-only TrustGraph Agent.

question.description: One focused question about the applicable business definition, rule, mapping, scope, unit, time boundary, or relationship.

context.description: Optional minimal disambiguating context: the blocked operation or decision, relevant source/table role, field names and types, a few non-sensitive representative values or masked value patterns, and explicit user constraints. Never send a whole table, raw sensitive values, or full conversation.
